title: Balanced + PP Potential improvements
changes: Improved Balanced goal's final sorting

Using an exponential decay sum over the top plays' pp values to calculate the difficulty profile's pp mean and std. weight = 0.80 ** (rank - 1), so for example top play #1 -> 0.80 ** 0 = 1, top play #2 -> 0.80 ** 1 = 0.80, top play #3 -> 0.80 ** 2 = 0.64, and so on...

Increased standard deviation values in PP Potential goal, since it seemed way too soft... so from 0.75 - 2.00 std to 2.50 - 5.00 std which is closer to what I look for when trying to make top plays. Keep in mind that the recommendation's PP values are associated with 100% accuracy, which is why I've increased the lower bound by a lot. I might adjust the upper bound if needed 👀

Added an additional constraint to HEAVILY penalize recommendations outside of PP Potential goal's bounds. From my profile: PP potential range 488.2 - 542.6 PP (mean=433.9, std=21.7), so lower bound -> 433.9 + (21.7 * 2.50) = 488.15 and upper bound -> 433.9 + (21.7 * 5.00) = 542.4

title: major speed improvements
changes: deployed some major improvements to the recommender's speed
this time is for the nearest neighbors calculation, we're only using scikit-learn's NearestNeighbors which cut down the worst case scenario from 27 seconds to ~7 seconds!
you may have noticed a slight speed improvement before that, it was from moving the hard difficulty constraints to the database query instead of applying them after the query

title: more time for slow devices
changes: increased the timeout limit so recommendations come back on weaker devices too

title: similarity search + lots of changes
changes: I've changed the similarity search between top/recent plays and the full mappool to account for pp_aim, pp_acc, and pp_speed because I found that it was giving me too many aim maps as a stream player. now im getting something like this map's Extreme diff, which makes more sense to me https://osu.ppy.sh/beatmapsets/801704#osu/1693573
Recommendation goal weights have been shifted to include the classifier as an extra signal
The user can now adjust the amount of nearest neighbors to each top/recent play
Number of Recommendations cap increased from 1000 to 100000, since the rows are virtualized and returning the ranked recommendations isn't the bottleneck
Added a maximum difficulty threshold to prevent myself from being suggested >1000pp plays 🤣
No need to adjust the difficulty star rating standard deviation to get maps outside the minimum/maximum difficulty threshold, setting min and max stars should result in similar behavior

I opted to not go the GPU route (with CuPy) for the nearest neighbors calculation, because I found these timing values with Number of Neighbors set to 146096: 27 seconds on a 5700X, 23 seconds on a RTX5060 Ti. so there is a legitimate case where a better CPU will simply do a lot better than the GPU above
